item.virtual_redstone_wire.virtual_cable:
Right-click an input block,
then an output block,
to create a one-way redstone link

Max distance: 256 blocks.
Signal strength propagates along the link
Right-click an input block
to cut all links originating from it

Only affects links where this block
is the input (source)
item.virtual_redstone_wire.cable_magnifi:
While held, highlights all links:
blue is input, yellow is output,
red is link path

Sneak-right-click a block
to inspect its links
message.virtual_redstone_wire.too_far: Target is too far away! Max distance: %d blocks
config.virtual_redstone_wire.maxLinkDist: Maximum distance (in blocks) for a virtual cable connection
